title: WPA AI External Review Protocol
review_domains: separation of AI assistance from institutional authority
reviewer_profiles: academic researchers in AI governance or responsible AI
minimum_independence_controls: reviewer comments cannot silently modify WPA doctrine
material findings enter a governance decision log
public claims distinguish review from accreditation or endorsement
human_authority_rule: External reviewers may evaluate and recommend; doctrinal and institutional authority remains with the authorised human governance structure.
activation_note: This protocol is active as a governance standard. It does not claim that named external reviewers or an active AAB already exist.
